Ptilopsis:BootThread.NAME: Boot Thread
Ptilopsis:BootThread.DESCRIPTION: Create 1 empty Mutable Thread. NL Gain !B! Block. NL Draw !M! card.

Ptilopsis:ReadOnlyThread.NAME: Read-Only Thread
Ptilopsis:ReadOnlyThread.DESCRIPTION: Retain. Exhaust. NL Install a Fixed Thread: when constructed and at end of turn, gain !B! Block. NL When destructed, draw !M! card.

Ptilopsis:WakeRoutine.NAME: Wake Routine
Ptilopsis:WakeRoutine.DESCRIPTION: Draw !M! cards. NL Install a Fixed Thread: at start of turn, draw !M! cards. NL When triggered or destructed, gain [E] and draw 1 card.
Ptilopsis:WakeRoutine.UPGRADE_DESCRIPTION: Innate. NL Draw !M! cards. NL Install a Fixed Thread: at start of turn, draw !M! cards. NL When triggered or destructed, gain [E] and draw 1 card.

Ptilopsis:CacheRefresh.NAME: Cache Refresh
Ptilopsis:CacheRefresh.DESCRIPTION: Exhaust. NL Draw !M! card. Draw 1 more for each mounted Thread.

Ptilopsis:QuickIteration.NAME: Quick Iteration
Ptilopsis:QuickIteration.DESCRIPTION: Exhaust. NL Add !M! random Ptilopsis cards to your hand. They cost 0 and Exhaust.

Ptilopsis:Offline.NAME: Offline
Ptilopsis:Offline.DESCRIPTION: Choose up to !M! cards in your hand and Exhaust them. NL Install a Fixed Thread: at end of turn, play copies in order for free. Attacks target random enemies. NL When destructed, gain !B! Block.
EXTENDED_DESCRIPTION: Choose cards to pack (you may choose fewer)

Ptilopsis:Magallan.NAME: Magallan
Ptilopsis:Magallan.DESCRIPTION: Retain. Exhaust. NL Whenever you play another card, this costs 1 less this combat. NL After this turn ends, take an extra turn.

Ptilopsis:Muelsyse.NAME: Muelsyse
Ptilopsis:Muelsyse.DESCRIPTION: She will help you at the right moment! NL Heal !M! HP. NL Exhaust.

Ptilopsis:Closure.NAME: Closure
Ptilopsis:Closure.DESCRIPTION: Innate. Exhaust. NL Spend up to !M! Gold. NL Upgrade all cards this combat. NL After winning this combat, upgrade 1 random card in your deck.
